newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may restructure 15 big tax debtors end-May.
newsitem.headline: Russia may restructure 15 big tax debtors end-May.

text.p: The Russian government will review plans to restructure tax debts of 15 major tax debtors into government-held equity at the end of May, Interfax news agency quoted Privatisation Minister Alfred Kokh as saying on Thursday.

The discussion will be followed almost immediately by practical work on the restructuring, which will include oil companies such as Yuganskneftegaz, Nizhnevartovskneftegaz, Kondpetroleum and Noyabrskneftegaz, the main unit of non-ferrous metals producer Norilsk Nickel and subsidiaries of gas monopoly Gazprom, it quoted Kokh as saying.
